title: Next label for an instruction counter
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols. The map from instruction identifiers to labels sends $E$ to the copy label for $F$, $U$ to the length-check label, $E2$ to the copy label for $F2$, $U2$ to the second length-check label, and $C$ to the center-read label.
